enableShopSystem.name: Enable Shop System
enableShopSystem.hint: Enables the Shop actor type. If deactivated, existing shops are hidden and new ones can't be created.

placeholders.noItems: This shop has no items yet.

settings.repDescription: Which Rep networks this shop deals in - only these appear as payment options for buying, selling, or cashing in a Favor here.
settings.valuationDescription: Maps each item's own cost tier to this shop's effective cost tier, Free through Rare. Rare gates behind Loyalty (if enabled) independent of price; Rep-Test difficulty and price are set separately below, in Difficulty Mapping.
settings.difficultyMappingDescription: Remaps this shop's own effective cost tiers (set above in Item Valuation) onto the Favor tier used for Rep-Test difficulty and price - lets you make every Minor-tier item here roll or cost like Moderate, without touching which items are Minor in the first place. A Free item stays free unless its Trivial row is remapped here.
settings.loyaltyPerTierDescription: Buying an item or cashing in a Favor grants the buyer loyalty with this shop, scaled by the item's own cost type (not the shop's Rep-tier valuation). Selling never grants loyalty.
settings.loyaltyRecordsDescription: A live list of every character's current standing at this shop - not a setting, just their tracked Loyalty value. Edit a value directly to correct it manually.
settings.loyaltyRecordsEmpty: This shop has no loyal customers yet.
settings.loyaltyRecordDeleteConfirm: This will permanently delete this character's loyalty record with this shop.
settings.loyaltyRecordAddHeadline: Select a character to add to this shop's loyalty list.
settings.loyaltyBarMaxDescription: The highest Loyalty value this shop tracks. The footer's color bar and marker are scaled against this number.
settings.loyaltyBarDescription: Splits the bar into four percentage bands (Red/Orange/Yellow/Green). Together they can never exceed 100% of the Maximum Loyalty above.
settings.sellLimitsDescription: Caps how much a character can sell to this shop in one transaction. Reaching a limit locks the character out of further sales here until a long rest, or until the Owner clears it below.
settings.sellLockoutsEmpty: No characters have hit the sell limits yet.
settings.sellLockoutsDescription: Characters currently locked out of selling here after reaching a Sell Limit above - clear a lockout to let them sell again before their next long rest.
settings.loyaltyBuyDiscountDescription: Percentage discount on Buy, redeemable per Loyalty Tier - spending it drops standing back down by that many Tiers.
settings.generalOverridesDescription: Sets the shop's baseline prices. Lets you quickly make this shop more expensive or cheaper across the board.
settings.morphPointOverridesDescription: This option only exists in Homebrew, since Morphs normally aren't purchasable and are instead accounted for via a different point system. Each value is the Morph Points threshold where that tier begins - lower point costs fall through to a lower tier automatically. If two thresholds are set to the same value, the higher tier wins.
settings.specificOverridesDescription: For finer-grained shop tuning - for example, if certain Rep is less welcome in some places than others. Any slot left blank falls back to the base value, or the General Override if one is set.
